items.title: Nobody warns you about Way of Peace.
items.text:
Nobody warns you about Way of Peace.

The Way of Peace by James Allen

Follow ShelfMade for a new classic-book lesson every day. Full videos on YouTube.

Nobody warns you about Way of Peace.

Armored in changeless Truth, what can he know Of loss and gain?

Truth cannot be limited; it can never be the special prerogative of any man, school, or nation, and when personality steps in, Truth is lost

Error is involved in the darkness of unfathomable complexity, but eternal simplicity is the glory of Truth

It is given to the world to learn one great and divine lesson, the lesson of absolute unselfishness

There are no difficulties in Truth, and coming to Truth, you will be freed from all sorrow and disappointment

But the lovers of Truth worship Truth with the sacrifice of self, and ceaselessly guard themselves against worldliness and self-seeking

The holy man is divinely wise; he alone knows Truth in its fullness, and has entered into abiding rest and peace

That eminent Christian saint and philosopher, Jacob Boehme, realized his vast knowledge of divine things whilst working long hours as a shoemaker

Source: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/10740

Evidence: Steven Pinker (2011, Western Europe): homicide rates fell from about 30 to 6 per 100,000; Robert Putnam (2015, United States): neighbor trust fell from about 30% to about 15%
